chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: Loggins Catering and Roy Loggins
summary: The catering business stood a block from Music Town, and Roy Loggins became a jazz disc jockey.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And where was that in relation to where Loggins Catering was?
Loggins Catering was down in the next block. A block down--down by where the Koreans are now, you know...where that Korean Church and things are. He was down on the next corner. Catering, yeah.
I know Roy Loggins, Mr. Loggins' son who became a jazz disc jockey.
Did he? Yeah, there was two of those Loggins boys.
Right. Roy and...I can't think of his brother's name. I only know Roy.
Yeah, he started...he got a radio program somewhere in the middle '40s on a station in Pasadena.
I know when he started. Yeah.
In fact, he's still on the air on a station in Palm Springs.
